newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares rally driven by Endesa.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares rally driven by Endesa.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed sharply higher, with the bolsa driven by rollercoaster speculative trade in power giant Endesa, which announced its annual results Thursday, said traders.
The market is expected to open steady as blue chips are seen hitting resistence, said Guillermo Tagle, head of research at Santander Investments.
"110 points (on the IPSA index) seems the level of equilibrium for the long term," said Tagle.
The selective index ended up 1.63 percent at 109.84 points.
The general index gained 0.87 percent at 5,206.91 points on volume of 10.2 billion pesos.
Blue chips powered over two percent higher in mid-afternoon trade on speculation Endesa would report strong earnings, traders said.
Although Endesa's results were down on 1995, the company posted better fourth quarter earnings than analysts had been expecting, said Tagle.
Endesa, Chile's largest power utility, reported earnings falling 13 percent to 141.2 billion pesos.
Its stock ended up 4.55 percent at 253 pesos.
